sources.title: ICML Oral DR Tulu: Reinforcement Learning with Evolving Rubrics for ...
sources.snippet: In this work, we introduce Deep Research Tulu, a fully open AI model trained specifically for long-form deep research. The key idea is a new training method called Reinforcement Learning with Evolving Rubrics. Instead of using fixed grading rules, our method builds and updates evaluation rubrics during training.

sources.title: DR Tulu: An open, end-to-end training recipe for long-form deep ...
sources.snippet: To address these challenges, we introduce Deep Research Tulu (DR Tulu), the first open model that is directly trained for long-form deep research tasks through an end-to-end training recipe that combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning with Evolving Rubrics (RLER).

sources.title: DR-Tulu: Deep Research with Reinforcement Learning
sources.snippet: DR-Tulu is the first open deep research model directly trained for open-ended, long-form research using Reinforcement Learning with Evolving Rubrics (RLER).
